{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ortolan embassy''' was an embassy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was operated by representatives of the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After [[Sleta Suke]], the daughter of the Ortolan [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to Coruscant, became engaged, a lavish engagement party was held in the Ortolan embassy in her honor. However, the event was disrupted by the [[Lost Ones]] street gang, who attempted to abduct Suke.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
